thread:
lauren (People Ops): Launching something new: Culture Champions microgrants are open! We have 5 microgrants of $250 each to fund employee-led culture initiatives (team lunches, volunteer events, local meetups, diversity panels, etc.). Nominate yourself or a teammate by next Friday. Short form here: <https://forms.gle/culture-champs>

lauren (People Ops): A few rules up front: projects must be non-commercial, open to Redwood folks, and completed within 60 days of award. Winners must submit a brief 2-3 sentence recap + photo for our internal comms.

sam (People Ops): Adding that managers should confirm headcount impact if you're requesting food or venue bookings. For anything > $100 per person we need pre-approval from finance.

prashant (Eng): Nice! Can an eng guild use this for an offsite hackathon pizza + prizes?

lauren (People Ops): Yes, as long as it fits the guidelines and the budget. Please estimate per-person costs in the form and tag your manager for approval.

maria (CS): Question: are volunteer event costs (e.g., supplies, transit stipends for volunteers) eligible? We often need small budgets for kits.

sam (People Ops): Eligible. Mark the category as "volunteer" on the form and include receipts/attendee list in the recap. We'll prioritize events with measurable impact.

oliver (Legal): Quick legal note: if prizes or grants go to contractors, we need a contract addendum or to route via vendor payments. Employees are fine. Please check with me before committing funds to non-employees.

ethan (Finance): Tax/ops: $250 grants are processed as taxable benefits for US employees. For international folks, tax treatment varies by country; we'll need legal payroll codes. Please include legal name and country in the form. For physical swag, allow 3 weeks for fulfillment.

prashant (Eng): Good to know. Any restrictions on how many nominations per person? could a person be on multiple team proposals?

lauren (People Ops): One submission per project. You can be on multiple projects, just submit separate forms. Committee will consider overlap and distribute awards widely.

sam (People Ops): Selection process: People Ops + 1 cross-functional rep + one exec sponsor will review. We'll publish winners two business days after close and route funds within 10 business days.

maria (CS): Can managers also nominate for spot recognition tied to these events (like best volunteer organizer)? We have a volunteer who deserves a shoutout.

lauren (People Ops): Absolutely. We're running microgrants and spot recognitions in parallel this cycle. Use the same form and mark "spot recognition" if you just want to nominate an individual (no budget requested).

recognition-bot: Reminder set: nomination window closes in 6 days. :bell:

oliver (Legal): One more: any data we collect (attendee lists, photos) needs consent if used in comms. Add a line in your recap confirming consent was obtained.

ethan (Finance): Also tagging budget code: CULT-OPS-2026. Managers, if you approve spend, please confirm the budget code in the sheet.

prashant (Eng): Great. Will share with the eng guild channel. Can we get a short FAQ we can paste?

sam (People Ops): I'll draft an FAQ snippet and post in #general + pin to the form. Key Qs: who can apply, timeline, receipts, tax notes, international shipping, contractor rule.

lauren (People Ops): TL;DR: 5x $250 microgrants, nominate via form by next Fri, manager confirmation required for spend, legal & finance notes above, recap + photo due within 60 days. I'll follow up with the Google Sheet export and approval checklist. :tada:
